title: achillea ptarmica subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Achillea ptarmica subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as mountain mayweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and relieve stress. The health benefits of mountain mayweed include its ability to soothe digestive issues, such as bloating and gas, and its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alantolactone, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
